summary: PowerBank Corporation filed a Form 6-K on May 21, 2026, attaching a press release announcing the execution of three lease agreements for battery energy storage projects in upstate New York totaling 60 MWh capacity. The projects are expected to qualify for NYSERDA incentives and VDER compensation. This is an operational business development disclosure with no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, or deal termination event. The filing is a routine current report of a foreign private issuer disclosing new project leases, which is not a special situation.
